No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result 2027: Zamfara APC Roots For Gov Lawal, Unveils 900-Member Campaign Team by Nicholas Dekera 6 seconds ago in News Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram The Zamfara State chapter of the All Progressives Congress (APC) has constituted an over 900-member Gubernatorial Campaign Council to coordinate and drive the party’s campaign activities towards the 2027 general elections.
The constitution of the council followed extensive consultations and recommendations by the State chapter of the party.
According to a statement signed by the secretary of the council yesterday, the council was approved by Governor Dauda Lawal, the Executive Governor of Zamfara State and leader of the party in the state.
The council will be chaired by Governor Lawal, with the Deputy Governor, Malam Mani Mummuni, and the State APC chairman, Hon. Kabiru Moyi B/Magaji, serving as vice-chairmen.
The council is mandated to coordinate and drive the party’s campaign activities towards securing a resounding victory for the APC in the forthcoming election.
The statement said that in line with the party’s commitment to issue-based campaigns, the council would focus on showcasing the achievements of the administration over the past three years.
It urged all members to demonstrate commitment, unity, discipline and dedication to the collective success of the party, while ensuring strict compliance with the provisions of the Electoral Act and guidelines of the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC).
